about: James L. Bizzieri, the dedicated owner and attorney at Bizzieri Law Offices, LLC, in Chicago, Illinois, is a staunch advocate for clients seeking justice and compensation for damages caused by negligence or wrongful acts. Serving the South Side of Chicago, his legal competence spans a wide array of personal injury cases, including serious injuries, truck and car crashes, medical malpractice, workers' compensation, nursing home negligence, construction site accidents and dog bite incidents, among others.

Mr. Bizzieri's academic journey began with a Bachelor of Science degree in finance from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign in 2001. He then pursued his passion for law, earning his Juris Doctor from the University of Illinois Chicago School of Law in 2005, the same year he was admitted to practice law in Illinois.

Over the years, Mr. Bizzieri has garnered numerous accolades, reflecting his commitment to excellence in the legal field. He has been recognized as an Emerging Lawyer by the Leading Lawyers in America. His prowess in the courtroom has earned him a spot in the Top 100 Trial Lawyers by the National Trial Lawyers. Additionally, he has received the "10 Best" award from the American Institute of Personal Injury Lawyers and the Top 10 Attorney Award from the National Academy of Personal Injury Attorneys.

With over two decades of experience in personal injury law, Mr. Bizzieri is renowned for his ability to secure substantial claims for his clients in Chicago. He meticulously prepares each case, focusing on maximizing compensation. His approach involves a thorough investigation of the accident circumstances, enlisting adept testimony when necessary and crafting a compelling case to present to insurers or in court, ensuring that his clients receive the damages they deserve. His dedication and skill have earned him a "Superb" rating on Avvo, further cementing his reputation as a leading personal injury attorney.
